**Visual observations from test image:**
- Plant at ground level with a mix of green, yellow, and brown dead leaves
- Several leaves showing yellowing with remaining green tissue (interveinal pattern)
- Some fully brown/dead leaves, plant appears to be declining
- Lower canopy affected with progression visible

**Analysis:**
The interveinal chlorosis pattern — yellow tissue between veins while veins stay greener — along with the browning necrosis and overall plant decline matches Sudden Death Syndrome (SDS). The SDS reference confirms this pattern: scattered yellow diffuse spots between veins expanding to brown necrotic lesions surrounded by chlorotic areas, with leaf curling. The symptom description notes "scattered yellow diffuse spots between veins that expand to become brown lesions surrounded by chlorotic areas; leaves may be cupped or curled." This matches the test image well.
